abilities.name: Backstab
abilities.description: Passive enhancement to normal attacks from behind (+75%) or concealment (+100%); successful hits apply six seconds of bleed.

cast.description: Two slim daggers cut a fast close crossing arc, dry cloth motion and focused blade hiss. Isolated game sound effect, no music, no speech, clean short tail.

impact.description: Precise dagger puncture with a compact leather-like bite and dark magical tick, no exaggerated gore. Isolated game sound effect, no music, no speech, clean short tail.

notes: This is a passive qualifying attack demonstration, not an extra active ability or cooldown.
Bleed is 10 damage per second for 6 seconds; status lifetime and stacking belong to gameplay.
Backstab source mentions concealment smoke, but current smoke_screen.md defines Misdirection without concealment; no concealment is invented for that field.

abilities.name: Shadow Step
abilities.description: Dash four tiles forward over 200 ms through enemies and hazards, followed by 800 ms of invulnerability.

cast.description: A fast purple shadow tear and airy dimensional rush, subtle low whisper texture without words. Isolated game sound effect, no music, no speech, clean short tail.

impact.description: A crisp dimensional snap as a stealthy cat materializes, soft landing with a purple glass chime. Isolated game sound effect, no music, no speech, clean short tail.

notes: Base description says instantaneous teleport, but detailed mechanics specify a 200 ms dash; preview follows the explicit transit timing.
Facing determines four-tile path; valid endpoint and solid-wall checks belong to gameplay.
Invulnerability starts immediately and totals 1 s. Actor poses remain centered; world translation is external.

abilities.name: Misdirection
abilities.description: Create a six-second purple reversal zone at up to six tiles range; enemy abilities passing through its three-tile radius redirect or reverse allegiance.

cast.description: A compact reality-warping whoosh, twisting violet air and a small descending glass accent. Isolated game sound effect, no music, no speech, clean short tail.

impact.description: A sharp magical reversal flick, two quick opposite-direction swishes with a violet crystalline snap. Isolated game sound effect, no music, no speech, clean short tail.

sustain.description: Disorienting purple vortex ambience, low soft whisper-like air with counter-rotating crystalline echoes, no intelligible voices, seamless loop. Isolated game sound effect, no music, no speech, clean short tail.

notes: File smoke_screen.md is titled Misdirection; this entry preserves that current document’s actual mechanics rather than inventing smoke concealment.
Zone itself deals no damage; basic attacks, self-targeted abilities and terrain effects are unaffected.
114×114 field represents a six-cell diameter. Actual targeting/redirection remains gameplay-owned.

abilities.name: Pickpocket
abilities.description: While adjacent, hold 0.5–3 s and release to attempt stealing currency, items or buffs without interrupting the target’s scheduled behavior.

cast.description: A subtle nimble cloth and pouch rustle, a light gold clasp click. Isolated game sound effect, no music, no speech, clean short tail.

impact.description: A tiny satisfying coin cluster and delicate buff-transfer chime, quiet and precise. Isolated game sound effect, no music, no speech, clean short tail.

charge.description: Faint sustained fabric tension and careful fingers moving near a leather pouch, very quiet stealth anticipation. Isolated game sound effect, no music, no speech, clean short tail.

notes: Preview uses the minimum 500 ms hold and depicts a successful currency outcome only.
Hold tags may repeat until 3 s; release resolves success/detection and item tier in gameplay.
No guaranteed success or rare treasure is added; no damage or enemy interruption.
